title: Bernoulli sets: a model for random approximate sets
description: Final version (October 2026), with errata; superseded by the monograph Bernoulli Types: Two-Sided Error in Approximate Membership, Retrieval, and Computation, Chapters 2, 4, 5 and 7. A probabilistic framework for random approximate sets with independent element-wise false-positive and false-negative errors; two axioms yield the error-count distributions, their normal limits, and confidence intervals.
